title: Repair initial held-input sampling in the selected SDL3 provider
goal: Repair the reproduced SDK cache-initialization gap where SDL reports already-held controls but the first assigned SDK user reads zeros, using an isolated reviewed provider profile while preserving every existing SDK package and input contract.
acceptance: Retain MW3-085's Windows/Linux held-discovery failures and actual SDL-versus-SDK values; audit provider creation, current-state reads, event normalization and threading before choosing the minimal repair

Use an original licensed patch and a separate derived source/build/cache/package from the verified XMA profile; initialize the provider snapshot without changing guest mappings, user assignment, kernel imports, generated code or another lane's SDK

Bind exact parent/source/patch/compiler/configuration/library identities and an explicit replacement allowlist; preserve unaffected files and parents, and split any broader SDK or interface repair before implementation

Admit the new profile explicitly in the two diagnostic runners while preserving default XMA behavior; these shared runner paths are serialized after completed 084/085, not edited during their active claims
Make the unchanged held-discovery correctness case pass with actual loaded repaired-library proof; never remove the assertion, count a known failure as success or add success-valued input stubs
validation: Compare retained baseline and repaired native Windows/Linux results with identical original stimuli; rerun all user-routing and raw-provider cases, including held controls, packet changes, all 24 attach orders, hotplug, UI blocking, virtual rumble, stale events and wrong-routing controls

Run supported host and participating-library sanitizers, independently reconcile actual loaded library/source/binary/receipt identities and cleanup, and document unavailable instrumentation and physical hardware explicitly

Reject stale parents, wrong patch/package/replacement identities, changed unaffected files and incomplete/late/wrong outputs; run public game-free checks and record performance impact without a title benchmark claim
size: bounded host-provider repair and isolated profile; no title service admission
evidence: Original licensed provider patch preserves current SDL input at first SDK discovery through existing normalization, held-only alias aggregation, early add-event handle ownership, post-enqueue revision publication and synchronized pending-handle shutdown; no guest mapping or assignment interface changes

Three private exact-identity preparations replace only rexhid-sdl3 DLL/so, preserving complete verified XMA parents and every unaffected artifact; canonical source/header, patch, recipe, tool, compiler, actual CMake/Ninja/cache and loaded-library hashes in docs/engine/input-snapshot.md

All fifteen final Windows/Linux native, host-sanitizer and participating-base/provider sanitizer suites PASS/exit 0: 150 processes, 130 positives and 20 exact deliberate rejection controls; all ten original held-discovery failures now pass with unchanged assertions and contract sources

The unchanged original native Windows/Linux MW3-085 executables also pass held-discovery against the new provider, independently separating library repair from rebuilding the fixture; original baseline LIMITATION receipts/failures remain frozen

Artifact audit reconciles all 150 logs, 15 binaries/compile-command records, frozen sources/runners and SDK identities, with 140 actual loaded-library records. Ten unchanged raw negative controls lack a pre-failure module record and are explicitly limited to exact command/package/binary/diagnostic evidence

Five actual private invalid patch/parent/provider/unaffected-library/replacement-list controls are rejected; private hardlink entries are broken before mutation and original SDKs/parents verified unchanged. Twelve new public game-free synthetic receipt/admission/lifecycle guards pass

Public checks PASS: Windows Release 193 Python tests/eight existing documented platform/link/tool skips plus CTest 1/1; Linux Release ASan/UBSan 193 tests/two Windows-junction skips plus CTest 1/1. No sanitizer finding in exercised coverage; native HID-system/SDL, vptr and Windows core/provider instrumentation limits retained

Owner self-review only. New profile is explicit opt-in in completed 084/085 runners; default XMA and main allocation/audio SDKs/worktrees/processes untouched. Physical controllers, controls held before SDL first open, mapping reloads, independent Linux hardware, guest/title input and gameplay remain unverified; no title performance or distribution claim; MW3-083/MW3-012 remain open
